recentItems.title: किरण कुमार ने रिश्वत लेने वाले पुलिस अधिकारी को सबक सिखाया | Mar Deb Goli Kehu Na Boli
recentItems.description:
Movie : Mar Deb Goli Kehu Na Boli
Starcast : Ravi Kishan, Gunjan Pant, Deepak Dubey, Kalpana Shah, Siddharth Rai, Brijesh Tripathi, Ayaz Khan, Kiran Kumar, 
Seema Singh, Jyoti Kothari, Asha Kothari etc.
Producer : Payal Dubey  
Director (s) : Jagdish A Sharma 
Music : Dhananjay Mishra 
Lyrics : Vinay Bihari 
Banner : Shree Krishna Creations

Synopsis:

This story of Bihar is based on the fearless dark cloud in the sky. Bihar’s underworld Don named ‘Kakka’ (Siddharth Roy) offers his political leader Satyawrat (Kiran Kumar) from his party the leadership of Chief Minister and does all illegal activities like – raid, robbery, shoplifting, rape under his rule. Whereas, Satyawrat is very loyal towards his work. He couldn’t tolerate this and calls A.C.P. Arjun Singh (Ravi Kishan) from Delhi. A.C.P. Arjun Singh changes his getup as singer and arrives at Bihar station and meets fraud sub-inspector Salim (Deepak Dube). Arjun Singh stays in Shanti Niwas where he meets Shanti (Gunjan Pant) they become friends which slowly turns into love, Arjun Singh understands the situation that Salim is in love with reporter Salma (Kalpana Shah) wherein Salma discloses all the illegal activities of Kakka on television. Because of this Kakka and Arjun Singh endup being enemies. In this fight Salim who has changed himself into good person supports Arjun Singh where Kakka’s friend Usman Bhai (Brijesh Tripathy) who is opposed politician supports Kakka.
What will be the consequences of this fight? Will A.C.P. Arjun Singh be able to bring back the peace in Bihar? Will Kakka be able to take revenge of his son’s death! Who has died in this fight? How long will Salim –Salma be able to support Arjun Singh? What happens to Kakka-Usman in this fight?
To know all this, one should definitely watch the movie which includes love, romance, action all in one, a family oriented movie.
“MAAR DE GOLI KEHU NA BOLI”
